text:
ravi: Hey team, quick ask — our family was preliminarily approved for a foster-to-adopt placement in India. I'd like to take parental leave that covers the in-country placement period (10 weeks tentatively, Feb 14Apr 25). Questions: 1) Can I split paid leave around travel for court dates? 2) Any special docs Payroll or Benefits need for an international adoption placement? 3) Will health coverage continue while I'm abroad? 4) Can I take my work laptop and hotspot?

michelle (People Ops): Huge congrats, ravi! Short answers: 1) Yes, we support fragmented leave around placement events — list specific date ranges on the Parental Leave Request and mark segments as "placement" or "post-placement". 2) For international adoptions we need the placement letter and court filing docs + travel affidavit. Payroll may need extra forms for cross-border stays. 3) Benefits (medical) typically continue for approved parental leave; confirm if you need premium remittance while abroad. 4) IT travel is allowed but open an Equipment Travel ticket; export paperwork may take 10 business days.

jules (Payroll): From Payroll: please upload the placement approval letter, passport copy, and proposed travel itinerary. Adoption placements can affect tax credits — we'll flag any withholding differences. If you're working remotely while abroad (even occasionally), inform us so we can run nexus analysis.

ana (sic) ravi: typo — that's ana (Manager).

ana (ana (Manager)): I'll approve the leave pending docs. For the mid-March review window, we can either accelerate the calibration meeting to before you leave or I can submit feedback and loop you in asynchronously. Let me know preference.

ravi: Prefer to do a quick 20-min touch Feb 7 before I travel. I'll upload docs this week and open the IT ticket.

it-bot: Reminder: open Equipment Travel ticket at https://redwood.internal/it/equipment-travel. Allow 10 business days for export paperwork and confirm insurance/shipping plan.

michelle (People Ops): Action items: Ravi  submit Parental Leave Request with date segments + placement docs by Jan 20; Jules  run payroll cross-border check once docs are in; Ana  schedule 20-min review on Feb 7. We'll confirm benefit premium arrangements after Payroll review.

ravi: Done — form submitted and placement letter uploaded. IT ticket IT-7012 opened. Thanks everyone :heart:
